newsitem.title: USA: Wall Street stocks higher in early trading.
newsitem.headline: Wall Street stocks higher in early trading.

text.p: Wall Street stocks headed higher in early trading on Thursday, following through on some late strength on Wednesday and supported by a steady bond market. PepsiCo is expected to open higher.
The Dow Industrials was up seven at 6,857. The 30-year long bond was up 8/32 to yield 6.81 pct.
